I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the rollback, which paged on-call.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the rollback, which paged on-call.
